text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My, what an immense crowd of people! New Year's truly is lively in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: Your Highness. Do you recall the promise you made in regards to going out today?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, I know. "Under no circumstances should I stray too far from the security team"!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But there really isn't any need for concern. I also have Trainer with m—ah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I completely forgot! Happy New Year, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let's make this year the best year ever!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This is the last year I have left… I want it to be full of joy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Not a single one will remain—all you'll have is those memories you love so much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, Air Shakur pressed Fine Motion about her time limit, leaving Fine looking rather tense.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm quite all right, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I haven't forgotten about anything. The ending to my story has been decided since the very beginning!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The duties of my house are absolute. Not only is it something I must do, it's also something I want to do.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Truth be told, I should be performing those duties now. Yet here I am, able to race and visit a Japanese shrine on New Year's! This is more than I could have ever hoped for.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: These three years are a gift everyone has given to me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes. A gift of the most wonderful dream, born from the kindness of everyone around me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This time has truly been so splendid and fun! It was truly precious and I hold it close to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm so grateful that I'll be able to return to my duties with these precious memories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, she's been like this from the beginning. She doesn't see her duties as a sacrifice—she truly wishes to do everything she can for others.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That's why I intend to enjoy every last second I have here! I won't leave with any regrets! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure those are her true feelings. Still…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's quite enough serious talk! I went to great effort to convince the captain to let me go out, so I want to see all the magnificent things I can today.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Would you be so kind as to escort me somewhere this fine New Year's Day?
choice_data_list: Let's sample some New Year's cuisine.
Let's tour some shrines and pray for a productive year.
Let's go a bit wild with some waterfall meditation.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh my. I get the feeling this is going to be wonderful! Let's hurry off! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We arrive at a high-class Japanese restaurant approved by her security team from a list I gave them earlier.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh! These are called "iwaibashi," right? Festive chopsticks?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes. Using them symbolizes eating with the gods, right? The gods eat from one end, while us mortals use the other.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The length also has meaning, as it's related to the number eight, which represents good omens in Japan. Another thing I found interesting is…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion is so well-versed in etiquette from all over the world, she actually ends up teaching me new things.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, that was thoroughly enjoyable! ♪ Thank you for escorting me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, that sounds fun! Let's hurry off! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we begin a tour of various shrines that I researched beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Right, that's done! On to the next one, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, are you okay? We have walked an awful lot today.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Come now, stand here and catch your breath! There are still two left. Don't give up now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion is much more into this than I was anticipating…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, that was thoroughly enjoyable! ♪ Thank you for escorting me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ooh! I'd love to try that! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: A moment, if you please. Do you mean you intend to sit under a rushing waterfall? This ritual sounds quite dangerous. I beg you to reconsider.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's true that trying this without any preparation could be dangerous. In that case…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Are you sure about this, Trainer? Having you try it out before me… It's almost like you're my food taster.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm worried about you! Promise you won't do anything rash.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: CRASHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer? Are you okay?! Your lips have turned completely blue!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Standing under the waterfall turns out to be a brutal, freezing cold experience. Having performed the ritual in Fine Motion's place, we leave it at that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, that was thoroughly enjoyable! ♪ Thank you for escorting me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Now, to show my appreciation for today, I'd like to escort you… to one of my favorite ramen shops!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Haha, because how could I not?! I mean, they're open on New Year's! That kind of customer service simply mustn't go unanswered!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's Fine Motion!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Oh my goodness… Uh, um, excuse me. I'm a big fan!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you for reaching out. I appreciate your support!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Oh! Um, you were amazing in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup! I'll never forget that race! …Anyway, see ya!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You'll never forget it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I… certainly hope not.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion casts her eyes downwards for a moment, but her usual bright smile quickly returns, and we head to the ramen shop.
